step1_analysis.circuit_type: Common-Source Amplifier with Miller Low-Pass Filter
step1_analysis.description: A common-source amplifier stage with a resistive load and explicit feedback capacitance. The feedback capacitor leverages the Miller effect to multiply its effective capacitance, creating a compact low-pass filter suitable for baseband channel selection without adding noisy series resistors.

DC_Gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * R1. With VDD=1.8V, Vbias=0.6V, Id~450uA, gm~5.7mS, R1=2kOhm, Gain = 11.4 V/V = 21.1 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the chosen bias current and load resistor. 21 dB is typical for a single stage with a 2k load.

Bandwidth_3dB.description: The -3dB cutoff frequency of the low-pass filter.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is set by the source resistance and the Miller-multiplied feedback capacitance. Can be tuned for specific baseband requirements.

Power_Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * Id. With VDD=1.8V and Id=450uA, P = 0.81 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A single baseband stage consumes a fraction of the total receiver power.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, low-frequency gain, and 3dB bandwidth of the Miller filter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Common-Source Amplifier with Miller Filter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param C1_val=100f
.param C2_val=200f
.param R1_val=2k
.param W_n=20u
.param L_n=0.15u

* DUT (Modified A1 to X1 for standard SPICE subcircuit compatibility)
C1 N0 GND {C1_val}
R1 VDD Vout {R1_val}
C2 N0 Vout {C2_val}
X1 N0 Vout amplifier

.subckt amplifier in out
XM1 out in GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
.ends

* Biasing and Sources
VVDD VDD GND 1.8
Vin N_in GND dc 0.6 ac 1
Rin N_in N0 1k

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(Vout)

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1Meg 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(Vout)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  
  * Assuming dc_gain is approx 21.1 dB, target is 18.1 dB for 3dB bandwidth
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=18.1 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
